verdict.rationale: Svelte has no service API to wrap: the OpenAPI probe found nothing, so there are no SDKs in the usual sense. Its official libraries and tooling do serve as the surface you build against. These include the Svelte compiler and runtime, SvelteKit, the `sv` CLI (create/add/check), and an official MCP server that helps agents write Svelte code. Missing for 10: SDKs in the conventional client-library sense, multi-language SDK coverage, and independent corroboration of building against these packages in agentic workflows.
